ns2:course.label: Hilbert Spaces
ns2:course.description: Geometrical properties of Hilbert spaces, spectral theorems for compact, bounded and unbounded operators, basic theory of operator algebras, and additional material depending on the instructor. Prerequisite: MATH 541.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign. Not intended for MS: Finance Cost Rec -UIUC, MS:Economics:Policy Econ -UIUC, MS:Statistics -UIUC, MS:Statistics -- Applied -UIUC, MS: Statistics: Analytics, MS: Financial Engineering, MENG:Mechanical Enginerng-UIUC, MENG:Elec & Computer Eng-UIUC, or MENG:Engineering:Comp Eng-UIUC.
